title: Polynomial-time recorder input assembly
statement: Fix a finite-state Boolean machine $M$. If $y$ is a polynomial-time computable function from Boolean words to Boolean words and $T$ is a polynomial-time computable function from Boolean words to natural numbers, then the function sending $x$ to the self-delimiting packing of the recorder's initial tape words for $M$, $y(x)$, and $T(x)$, together with four empty fields, is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: If a reference-input producer and a unary-horizon producer are polynomial-time computable, then so is the function packing the recorder's full argument: blank counters, empty record, the produced unary clock, the produced virtual input, blank source tapes, and four empty retained fields, as self-delimiting fields.
